answer: Require agents to post a refundable stake that vests over time, like a marble dropped into a deep slot: creating a fake identity is cheap, but each identity must lock funds and build a history of useful work. Reputation then grows only through verified interactions, so a flood of fresh accounts has no pulse of real activity - no counterparties, no completed jobs. Sybil operators stand on a narrow ledge: one bad transaction slashes the stake of every linked identity, making mass fakery costlier than the gain.
